en-US.author: WezOps
en-US.longDescription:
WezOps Agent collects telemetry from Windows machines (CPU, memory,
disks, services, Windows events, installed software) and reports it to
the WezOps dashboard. It also executes administrator-approved commands
(patch installation, antivirus scans, remote scripts) through a secure
WebSocket link.

After installation, register the agent with a tenant token obtained from
https://wezops.com/dashboard/settings?section=deploiement.
en-US.name: WezOps Agent
